sources.entry: mitmproxy - An interactive TLS-capable intercepting HTTP proxy for penetration testers and software developers.

summary.one_liner: mitmproxy is an interactive, TLS-capable intercepting HTTP proxy with a console interface, plus command-line (mitmdump) and web (mitmweb) front ends.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes mitmproxy as an interactive, SSL/TLS-capable intercepting proxy with a console interface for HTTP/1, HTTP/2, and WebSockets. It ships three interfaces: mitmproxy (interactive console), mitmdump (command-line version, described as tcpdump for HTTP), and mitmweb (web-based interface). The README is brief and does not detail specific inspection or scripting features. Installation instructions and full documentation are on the project website, and questions are directed to GitHub Discussions.
use_cases: capture HTTP traffic from the command line
how_to_run: See the mitmproxy website for installation instructions and precompiled binaries
To install from source, see CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository
notable: Three interfaces: console (mitmproxy), command-line (mitmdump), and web (mitmweb)
caveats: README is brief; detailed installation and usage are on an external website
Source installation is described in CONTRIBUTING.md rather than the README
